messages:
Jon Park: Hi team, I'm on day 1 and blocked. Okta activation link says 'no apps assigned' and 1Password shows pending. Can't access mail. Anyone know who to ping?
IT Support: Welcome Jon! Try https://redwood.okta.com and confirm your company email. If it says not assigned, tag the identity team.
Jon Park: Tried the Okta link. It shows 'Account not assigned' and no activation email in spam.
IT Support: @Samir (Identity) can you check license assignment?
Samir (Identity): Checking. Jon, DM me the email you used.
Jon Park: Sent dm (jon.park@example.com).
Samir (Identity): I see your user; the provisioning job failed earlier so Google Workspace wasn't attached. I'm reassigning the Workspace app and resending activation and 1Password invites now.
Okta Bot: Activation email sent to jon.park@example.com.
IT Support: If Okta doesn't prompt for MFA, go to Settings > Extra Verification after login and enroll (Okta Verify or WebAuthn).
Jon Park: Activated the Okta link, enrolled in Okta Verify, but Gmail still says access denied after SSO.
Samir (Identity): That usually means the Workspace license wasn't yet provisioned. I've manually granted a license and re-ran the sync. Try again in two minutes.
1Password Bot: Invitation resent to jon.park@example.com.
Jon Park: Works now — Gmail loaded and 1Password invite came through. Set up 1Password and enabled an authenticator.
IT Support: Great. Quick checklist we send to new hires: 1) ensure Okta activation 2) enroll MFA 3) clear cookies/use incognito 4) confirm Workspace license 5) escalate to identity with a screenshot.
Jon Park: All set. Thanks everyone!
Samir (Identity): Welcome to Redwood — ping me if anything else pops up.
